arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
transliteration: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar

translations.en.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
translations.en.pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
translations.en.yusufali: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
translations.id.indonesian: Telah dekat datangnya saat itu dan telah terbelah bulan.

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
transliteration: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr

translations.en.sahih: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
translations.en.pickthall: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
translations.en.yusufali: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan jika mereka (orang-orang musyrikin) melihat suatu tanda (mukjizat), mereka berpaling dan berkata: "(Ini adalah) sihir yang terus menerus".

arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
transliteration: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr

translations.en.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
translations.en.pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
translations.en.yusufali: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka mendutakan (Nabi) dan mengikuti hawa nafsu mereka, sedang tiap-tiap urusan telah ada ketetapannya

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
transliteration: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

translations.en.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
translations.en.pickthall: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
translations.en.yusufali: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah datang kepada mereka beberapa kisah yang di dalamnya terdapat cegahan (dari kekafiran).

arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
transliteration: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur

translations.en.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
translations.en.pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
translations.en.yusufali: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
translations.id.indonesian: Itulah suatu hikmah yang sempurna maka peringatan-peringatan itu tidak berguna (bagi mereka).

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
transliteration: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur

translations.en.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
translations.en.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpalinglah kamu dari mereka. (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) seorang penyeru (malaikat) menyeru kepada sesuatu yang tidak menyenangkan (hari pembalasan),

arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
transliteration: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
translations.en.pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
translations.en.yusufali: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
translations.id.indonesian: sambil menundukkan pandangan-pandangan mereka keluar dari kuburan seakan-akan mereka belalang yang beterbangan

arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
transliteration: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

translations.en.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
translations.en.pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
translations.en.yusufali: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka datang dengan cepat kepada penyeru itu. Orang-orang kafir berkata: "Ini adalah hari yang berat".

arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
translations.en.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
translations.en.yusufali: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebelum mereka, telah mendustakan (pula) kamu Nuh, maka mereka mendustakan hamba Kami (Nuh) dan mengatakan: "Dia seorang gila dan dia sudah pernah diberi ancaman).

arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
transliteration: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir

translations.en.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
translations.en.pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
translations.en.yusufali: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka dia mengadu kepada Tuhannya: "bahwasanya aku ini adalah orang yang dikalahkan, oleh sebab itu menangkanlah (aku)".

arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
transliteration: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir

translations.en.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
translations.en.pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
translations.en.yusufali: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami bukakan pintu-pintu langit dengan (menurunkan) air yang tercurah.

arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
transliteration: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

translations.en.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
translations.en.pickthall: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
translations.en.yusufali: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami jadikan bumi memancarkan mata air-mata air, maka bertemulah air-air itu untuk suatu urusan yang sungguh telah ditetapkan.

arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur

translations.en.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
translations.en.pickthall: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
translations.en.yusufali: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami angkut Nuh ke atas (bahtera) yang terbuat dari papan dan paku,

arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
transliteration: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir

translations.en.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
translations.en.pickthall: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
translations.en.yusufali: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
translations.id.indonesian: Yang berlayar dengan pemeliharaan Kami sebagai belasan bagi orang-orang yang diingkari (Nuh).

arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami jadikan kapal itu sebagai pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mau mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
translations.en.yusufali: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al-Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
translations.en.yusufali: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
translations.id.indonesian: Kaum 'Aad pun mendustakan (pula). Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
translations.en.yusufali: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghembuskan kepada mereka angin yang sangat kencang pada hari nahas yang terus menerus,

arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
transliteration: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir

translations.en.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
translations.en.pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
translations.en.yusufali: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
translations.id.indonesian: yang menggelimpangkan manusia seakan-akan mereka pokok korma yang tumbang.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
translations.en.yusufali: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur

translations.en.sahih: Thamud denied the warning
translations.en.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
translations.en.yusufali: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
translations.id.indonesian: Kaum Tsamudpun telah mendustakan ancaman-ancaman (itu).

arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
transliteration: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur

translations.en.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
translations.en.pickthall: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
translations.en.yusufali: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka berkata: "Bagaimana kita akan mengikuti seorang manusia (biasa) di antara kita?" Sesungguhnya kalau kita begitu benar-benar berada dalam keadaan sesat dan gila".

arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
transliteration: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

translations.en.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
translations.en.pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
translations.en.yusufali: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah wahyu itu diturunkan kepadanya di antara kita? Sebenarnya dia adalah seorang yang amat pendusta lagi sombong.

arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
transliteration: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir

translations.en.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
translations.en.pickthall: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
translations.en.yusufali: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
translations.id.indonesian: Kelak mereka akan mengetahui siapakah yang sebenarnya amat pendusta lagi sombong.

arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
transliteration: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
translations.en.yusufali: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami akan mengirimkan unta betina sebagai cobaan bagi mereka, maka tunggulah (tindakan) mereka dan bersabarlah.

arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
transliteration: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

translations.en.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
translations.en.pickthall: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
translations.en.yusufali: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan beritakanlah kepada mereka bahwa sesungguhnya air itu terbagi antara mereka (dengan unta betina itu); tiap-tiap giliran minum dihadiri (oleh yang punya giliran)

arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
transliteration: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar

translations.en.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
translations.en.pickthall: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
translations.en.yusufali: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka memanggil kawannya, lalu kawannya menangkap (unta itu) dan membunuhnya.

arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
translations.en.yusufali: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
translations.id.indonesian: Alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
transliteration: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
translations.en.yusufali: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menimpakan atas mereka satu suara yang keras mengguntur, maka jadilah mereka seperti rumput kering (yang dikumpulkan oleh) yang punya kandang binatang.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur

translations.en.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.
translations.en.pickthall: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
translations.en.yusufali: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
translations.id.indonesian: Kaum Luth-pun telah mendustakan ancaman-ancaman (nabinya).

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
translations.en.yusufali: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghembuskan kepada mereka angin yang membawa batu-batu (yang menimpa mereka), kecuali keluarga Luth. Mereka Kami selamatkan sebelum fajar menyingsing,

arabic: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
transliteration: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

translations.en.sahih: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
translations.en.pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
translations.en.yusufali: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
translations.id.indonesian: sebagai nikmat dari Kami. Demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang bersyukur,

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur

translations.en.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
translations.en.pickthall: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
translations.en.yusufali: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya dia (Luth) telah memperingatkan mereka akan azab-azab Kami, maka mereka mendustakan ancaman-ancaman itu.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
translations.en.pickthall: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
translations.en.yusufali: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya mereka telah membujuknya (agar menyerahkan) tamunya (kepada mereka), lalu Kami butakan mata mereka, maka rasakanlah azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
transliteration: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr

translations.en.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
translations.en.yusufali: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya pada esok harinya mereka ditimpa azab yang kekal.

arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

translations.en.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.
translations.en.pickthall: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
translations.en.yusufali: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka rasakanlah azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
transliteration: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur

translations.en.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
translations.en.pickthall: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
translations.en.yusufali: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah datang kepada kaum Fir'aun ancaman-ancaman.

arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
transliteration: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

translations.en.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.pickthall: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
translations.en.yusufali: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka mendustakan mukjizat Kami semuanya, lalu Kami azab mereka sebagai azab dari Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Kuasa

arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
transliteration: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur

translations.en.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
translations.en.pickthall: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
translations.en.yusufali: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah orang-orang kafirmu (hai kaum musyrikin) lebih baik dari mereka itu, atau apakah kamu telah mempunyai jaminan kebebasan (dari azab) dalam Kitab-kitab yang dahulu

arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
translations.en.pickthall: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah mereka mengatakan: "Kami adalah satu golongan yang bersatu yang pasti menang".

arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
transliteration: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur

translations.en.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
translations.en.pickthall: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
translations.en.yusufali: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
translations.id.indonesian: Golongan itu pasti akan dikalahkan dan mereka akan mundur ke belakang.

arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
transliteration: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr

translations.en.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya hari kiamat itulah hari yang dijanjikan kepada mereka dan kiamat itu lebih dahsyat dan lebih pahit.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
transliteration: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa berada dalam kesesatan (di dunia) dan dalam neraka.

arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar

translations.en.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) pada hari mereka diseret ke neraka atas muka mereka. (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Rasakanlah sentuhan api neraka!"

arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
transliteration: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan segala sesuatu menurut ukuran.

arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
transliteration: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar

translations.en.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
translations.en.pickthall: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
translations.en.yusufali: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan perintah Kami hanyalah satu perkataan seperti kejapan mata.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
transliteration: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

translations.en.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
translations.en.yusufali: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami binasakan orang yang serupa dengan kamu. Maka adakah orang yang mau mengambil pelajaran?

arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
transliteration: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur

translations.en.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.
translations.en.pickthall: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
translations.en.yusufali: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
translations.id.indonesian: Dan segala sesuatu yang telah mereka perbuat tercatat dalam buku-buku catatan

arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
transliteration: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar

translations.en.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
translations.en.pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.
translations.en.yusufali: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan segala (urusan) yang kecil maupun yang besar adalah tertulis.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu di dalam taman-taman dan sungai-sungai,

arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
transliteration: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir

translations.en.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
translations.en.yusufali: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
translations.id.indonesian: di tempat yang disenangi di sisi Tuhan Yang Berkuasa.
